title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Recent-Credit Hold on Program Refunds
content:
Refunds of program credit balances under the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** carry a hold on premium credits posted very recently.

**Recent-credit hold.** Tidemark holds back from the refundable credit, without taking it below zero, the whole of the premium credits posted in the last month when 5 or more premium credits were posted in that month, half (0.5) of them when 2 to 4 were posted, and nothing when fewer than 2 were posted.

"The last month" is the refund window of the last 1 month: it covers every premium credit posted on a day from which fewer than 1 whole calendar month has passed by today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached. Each premium credit entry on the program account is one credit, whatever certificate it concerns.

| Premium credits posted in the last month | Held back |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | Nothing |
| 2 to 4 | Half of their total |
| 5 or more | Their whole total |

*Hypothetical:* three credits of 120.00, 410.50 and 89.50 dollars posted in the last month total 620.00 dollars; 310.00 dollars is held back.
